implementation_note: 分阶段接收为原稿既定遗物收存结果的二维动作实现；不新增人物身份、强制对话、资源或通行前置。上游必须实际接近并收得原物，不能只以wheelchair_gone造袋。

source_contract.manifest: {version:1, ready:true, bag_departed:true, exit_room:'lobby', exit_pos:[actual x,y], source_attempt:int, transport_receipt:String, bag_id:String, items:Array, packed_receipts:Dictionary, source_owners:Dictionary}
source_contract.arrival_hook: arrive_from_hospital() is called once at the real L2-to-L3 transition. Restore only restores JSON; it must not run the arrival hook again.
source_contract.ownership: Each original item stays owned by manifest.bag_id; only the bag owner changes at actual arrival, nurse contact and placement. No loose L2 object is moved by this module.
